faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.

modelPlan.focus: Analyze the primary factors contributing to the difficulty in maintaining healthy eating habits in modern society.
outline: Body 1: Busy Lifestyle and Time Constraints
Body 2: Influence of Food Marketing and Availability
keyArguments: The fast-paced lifestyle and busy schedules make it challenging for individuals to prepare and consume regular, healthy meals.
The prevalence of processed and fast foods, coupled with aggressive food marketing, leads to poor dietary choices.
